Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent repeatedly failed to distinguish between "Pieter van Vollenhoven" (the son, born 1939) and "Pieter van Vollenhoven Sr." (the father, born 1897). Despite the Planner explicitly instructing the agent to search for the father's date of birth and noting that previous results only provided the year 1897, the WebSurfer continued to run the same search queries that returned the son's birth date (April 30, 1939) or the father's year (1897) without a specific day/month. Crucially, in Step 4, the agent hallucinated a specific date ("April 30, 1897") based on an auto-generated snippet ("Auto-generated based on listed sources. May contain inaccuracies") rather than verifying it against the actual Wikipedia page content which only listed the years (1897-1977). This led to a confident but incorrect specific date being presented as a fact, failing the core task of finding the verified date of birth.
